organization.name: Collabora Productivity
organization.notes: Collabora Productivity incorporated September2013; broader Collabora consultancy founded2005. Official About calls Productivity a division of Collabora. Exact equity ownership/private listing status, financing history and investor identities not verified from inspected primary sources; no bootstrapping assumption.

pricingTiers.name: CODE
pricingTiers.notes: Rolling development build for home/testing/startups; vendor does not recommend CODE for production. Paid supported edition separate.
No public Most popular or Recommended plan designation found in the source inspected; no popularity inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Collabora Online for Business
pricingTiers.notes: Published USD$3.40/user/month; official FAQ says subscriptions based on yearly price, so annual total $3.40×12=$40.80. Up to99 users. Monthly-billed charge not verified; quote confirms final terms.

pricingTiers.name: Collabora Online for Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: 100+ users; personalized volume discounts/contact sales, no fixed numeric enterprise price.

moats.claim: LibreOffice-derived format/rendering expertise and WOPI integration ecosystem create substantial engineering specialization, though standards allow competing editor engines.

productReasons.claim: Writer, Calc, Impress and Draw cover collaborative text, spreadsheets, presentations and diagrams.
Pivot tables, formulas and per-user spreadsheet views support analytical spreadsheet work alongside collaboration.
Change tracking and history-based review workflows help teams inspect and control document revisions.

sponsorship.notes: Official company About identifies business developing Online and contributing LibreOffice engineering. Separate corporate financial/in-kind sponsor roster not found; business-steward fallback; integration partners not automatic sponsors.

requirements.notes: CODE prebuilt Docker available for x86-64 and arm64, with ppc64le listed in SDK; no Windows-native server assumption.
Prebuilt image contains editor engine runtime; native Linux package path also exists.
Nextcloud/ownCloud or custom WOPI host provides persistent documents, access control and users; engine itself does not provide complete document platform.

requirements.component: Reverse proxy with WebSocket support and TLS
requirements.notes: Official integration guide recommends Apache/nginx reverse proxy; secure browser/WOPI URLs must be configured.

requirements.component: Database/cache services for integrated storage platform
requirements.condition: Only if WOPI host requires them
requirements.notes: No standalone SQL/Redis/RabbitMQ requirement for CODE engine verified; dependencies belong to chosen Nextcloud/other host.

resources.cpu: Vendor sizing expectation: about10 users per CPU thread
resources.memory: About1 GB system overhead plus50 MB per user, per vendor guidance
resources.os: Linux server/VM; Docker image predominantly tested on Linux
resources.notes: Vendor capacity estimates, not guaranteed hardware minima. Document size/complexity changes usage; bandwidth guidance about100 kbit/s per user. No fixed storage minimum verified.

selfHosting.notes: CODE is rolling development edition, not a stable production release. Current official FAQ plus SDK25.04 installation chapter used because current HTML SDK hit bot challenge; current official Nextcloud app metadata confirms supported built-in integration. WOPI host dependencies must be budgeted separately.

options.name: Nextcloud built-in CODE Server
options.notes: Collabora Productivity authored app for existing Nextcloud. Needs Nextcloud Office integration and platform requirements; app edition has different operational characteristics from standalone Docker.

oneClickInstall.notes: First-party Collabora-authored built-in CODE Server can be installed through existing Nextcloud App Store. This is an app marketplace integration, not independent turnkey cloud deployment. Manual Docker instructions alone not counted.
